responsibility: This host-configuration header defines the execution-environment conventions for building and running GCC on a VMS host with a Unix-style C library. It enables VMS host conditionals, selects POSIX-style exit and stdio behavior, sets host file suffixes and dumpfile naming, provides ordinary-file deletion semantics suitable for VMS versioned files, adjusts host printf formats for long pointers, and establishes the standard startfile prefix used by host-side driver and build logic.
